title: Checks
intro: I'm a security researcher. My recent work is on checking what AI coding agents claim to have done.

Before an agent runs, I record what should happen. Afterwards, a check compares that record with what did happen. This page is generated from those records, so failed checks are listed alongside passed ones.
Based in Sydney. Available for senior engineering roles and consulting.

paragraphs.text: An agent's work is judged against predictions registered before its plan was approved.
paragraphs.why: The judgement runs on a frozen snapshot of the run, not on the repository as it is now, so nothing changed afterwards can affect the result. The check fails if the judgement reads live state.
paragraphs.previously: An earlier run passed on 2026-11-02, before the prediction was registered.
